thread:
alex: starting nightshift canary for py/ts SDKs now. targeting cohort=orbital (low traffic window). pinback plan drafted. :rocket:

deploy-bot: queued deploy: py-sdk@1.14.0-canary, ts-sdk@0.9.2-canary -> cohort=orbital. ETA ~ 12m. use /deploy status for updates.

maya: quick ask — release notes are embargoed until 05:00 PST. any changelog text must not mention specific customer IDs or internal test clusters.

samir: noted. also reminder from last night: we saw signer-drift on one wheel, which triggered a yank. can we add a transient dist-tag pin to avoid clients picking the new artifact if something flaps?

jen: +1. propose pinback to stable for ~30m after canary if checksum/signature anomalies detected. deploy-bot supports a `--pinback` flag we can use.

alex: sounds good. run with pinback enabled. if any failure >3% 5m error rate we abort and rollback.

lia: I'll handle the embargoed release notes. will scrub PII and add deprecation blurb for legacy sync client. drafting now.

samir: example pinback command (for ops runbook):

```
/deploy canary --services py-sdk@1.14.0-canary ts-sdk@0.9.2-canary --cohort orbital --pinback
```

jen: deploy-bot, confirm you will create a revert PR automatically on artifact publish failure?

deploy-bot: yes — if publish step fails or checksum mismatch occurs, I will: 1) yank the artifact, 2) post a revert PR to repo infra/release, 3) notify #eng-oncall and the thread. I will also set dist-tag `stable` back to previous if `--pinback` is set.

maya: good. small product ask — call out the deprecation timeline (2.0 removal) in the release notes, but only in generic terms: "legacy sync client will be deprecated in the next major" (no dates).

alex: agreed. lia, include that phrasing.

ops-bot: lightweight alert — last night we had 1 slow publish to eu-west-1 (timeout on signing service). signing-team pinged and will be on standby for tonight.

samir: if signing service is flaky, we should fallback to re-run signing in a different region before yanking. ops runbook step: retry-sign(region=us-west-2) -> if still failing, yank.

jen: putting that in the playbook. also enabling `--stagger=5m` so ts and py publish do not race on the signer.

alex: small hotfix candidate exists that should go to canary first (docs-only change that affects packaging metadata). can we include it?

maya: docs-only, ok. just ensure wheel checksum is checked. lia please mention in notes: "docs packaging metadata tweak — should not affect runtime behavior."

lia: will add. also tagging the release notes as embargoed and shared with legal for PII check.

deploy-bot: publish started: py-sdk wheel upload -> in progress.

deploy-bot: py-sdk wheel upload -> success (sha256: abc123...def).

deploy-bot: ts-sdk npm publish -> in progress.

deploy-bot: ts-sdk npm publish -> success (dist-tag: orbital-canary).

ops-bot: smoke checks kicked off: basic import tests, sample generator flow, unpack-and-verify checksums.

samir: smoke checks passing (local run). 1 test flaky in tokenization but unrelated to packaging.

alex: still holding on final rollout to stable until 05:00 PST and until lia confirms release notes are cleared.

lia: release notes scrubbed and approved by legal. deprecation blurb added. ready to un-embargo at 05:00 PST.

jen: setting follow-up tasks: if anything fails after promoting, we rollback and pin stable to previous artifact for 30m. I've updated the runbook doc with the exact commands.

alex: thanks. final go: keep `--pinback` enabled, `--stagger=5m`, monitor token-level errors. ops-oncall @samir to watch first 15m after promotion.

samir: watching. I'll post updates here. :eyes:

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled at 05:00 PST -> promote orbital-canary -> stable. Will post live updates.

alex: great job team. small retrospective item: add an automated changelog scrub step to the CI so embargo mistakes don't slip.

lia: noted, will open a tiny GH issue.

ops-bot: reminder: if you need to trigger an immediate rollback, run:

```
/deploy rollback --artifact py-sdk@1.14.0-canary --reason "checksum/signature" --notify=eng-oncall
```

alex: thread locked to reduce noise; pls ping here for criticals.

samir: 05:03 PST — post-promotion check: no regressions detected in canary cohort after 3m. all clear for wider rollout in the morning. :white_check_mark:

jen: will flip stable tag at 05:10 PST and update release notes link.

deploy-bot: stable tag updated -> py-sdk@1.14.0, ts-sdk@0.9.2.

lia: release notes published (link masked until GA announcement).

alex: closing orbital window. follow-ups: lia create GH issue for changelog scrub CI, jen add retry-sign step to runbook, samir add signing-region fallback alert. thanks everyone. :party_popper:
